Allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200` (exact), plus any subdomain of `*.pages.dev` and `*.workers.dev`.

**Where to add a new custom domain:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `origin` callback passed to `app.use('*', cors({...}))` (lines ~20–28). Add a new condition, e.g. `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.your-domain.com')`, inside the `if (...)` block before `return origin;`.

Note (per `worker/src/index.md`): Hono's `cors` origin array only matches exact strings, so wildcard subdomains require this function form — don't switch back to an array if you need wildcards. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 (CORS) for more.
